method: Nine AI-engineering postings from large and mid-size employers, supplied by a reader or read from the employer's public page on 2026-11-23. Each capability is coded R (stated as a requirement or core responsibility), P (preferred, nice-to-have or alternative) or blank (not mentioned). Coding is one reviewer's reading of the posting; full posting text is not redistributed. These cases are qualitative and are not pooled into research/skill-distribution.csv.

capabilities.en: Testing, CI/CD, containers and cloud deployment

capabilities.zh: 安全、Responsible AI 与模型风险
capabilities.en: Security, Responsible AI and model risk

cases.title: Software Engineer II - AI Engineering (MCAPS)
cases.notes: Copilot Studio and Power Automate agents; Azure OpenAI custom agents with structured outputs, tool calling, grounding, guardrails, human escalation; multi-agent routing and hand-offs; AI-first development practices.

cases.title: AI Engineer - Evisort Agentic Dev
cases.notes: States it is first and foremost a software engineering role; system design, scalability and performance are non-negotiable. LangChain/LlamaIndex agentic workflows, Docker/Kubernetes, Terraform/Helm/ArgoCD, OpenTelemetry, automated evaluation of retrieval and agent behaviour.

cases.title: Senior AI Engineer (Internal Audit)
cases.notes: Despite the title, the role is full-stack application work: Vue/Nuxt, Node.js, SQL Server, automated tests, containers, CI/CD, OAuth2/OIDC. AI appears only as a preference for AI coding assistants.

cases.title: Senior AI Engineer (Capital Markets and Commercial Banking)
cases.notes: Intelligent document processing, workflow automation and agentic systems; evaluation harnesses and guardrails; APIs and event-driven integration; model risk, data governance and privacy; forward-deployed experience is a plus.

cases.title: AI/ML Engineer
cases.notes: AI/ML hybrid on AWS (SageMaker, ECS, Lambda, Step Functions); data and MLOps pipelines; advanced RAG, vector databases, knowledge graphs and agentic frameworks; Responsible AI and model risk management.

cases.title: AI application engineer (full stack)
cases.notes: Python + React; RAG and intelligent document processing with citations and human-in-the-loop UX; tests covering AI interactions; sandbox to production promotion; Azure AI Foundry, AI Search, Document Intelligence, Databricks; Responsible AI and model risk.

cases.title: AI Engineer (Solutions Architecture)
cases.source: employer API (also in the main sample as a reviewed record)
cases.notes: Embedded with Solutions Architects; internal tools, agents and workflow automation; two of Ruby, Node.js, Python, Next.js; fluent with AI-assisted development but able to debug without it.

cases.title: Applied AI Engineer (Genie Code)
cases.notes: Agentic systems that author, train, deploy and monitor classical ML; infrastructure and systems engineers without ML background are explicitly welcome.

cases.title: Campus Graduate Engineer 2027 - AI Engineering (AI Security Research)
cases.notes: New-grad role: data structures, algorithms, OOP, APIs, testing and version control required; foundational AI/LLM understanding from coursework or projects; RAG, tool calling and agent projects, hackathons and open source preferred.
